programme.title: E39 - Bad Mood

programme.desc: Everyone learns about the gliding bird that is the Albatross. It soars without flapping it's wings! But how?!

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.desc: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekong’s banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the region’s abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

programme.title: E1 - Spring
programme.desc: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reef’s main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

programme.title: E2 - Summer
programme.desc: Feel the heat of summer’s arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

programme.title: E3 - Autumn
programme.desc: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

programme.title: The Case Of The Cold Fish
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: Esprit D'Amour
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?.

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taiwan. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky...

programme.title: 90’s Hotties Collection: Doctor Vampire
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May...

programme.title: He Lives By Night
programme.desc: A cuckolded husband becomes a cross-dressing night stalker, compelled to strike down any women he sees wearing white fish-net stockings. Leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake, he selects a female disc jockey as his next target...

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: E33
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E29
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.title: E33
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。
